entities.summary: Yosef "Yossi" Banai was an Israeli actor, singer, songwriter, comedian, and theatre director. He received the Israel Prize for Theater in 1998 and the Israeli Theater Prize in 2004. Banai was widely regarded as a prominent figure in Israeli performing arts.
